basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old software engineering student currently living in Seattle, Washington. My interests include exploring open-source technologies, particularly on Linux systems. I dislike overly complex jargon and prefer concise, clear instructions. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings, after my classes. I'm currently single and focus a lot on my studies and side projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I am currently pursuing a degree in computer engineering and have a keen interest in software development. Most of my knowledge comes from academic coursework and numerous online tutorials. I am fairly new to practical applications and often seek help from online communities.
